name: Hello Robot Stretch 4
summary: A 46 kg, 1.6 m tall one-arm mobile robot with a telescoping arm on a lift that picks up to 2.5 kg at full reach on level indoor floors.

germany.statusNote: Sold direct by Hello Robot (USA) through a request-for-quote form that lists Germany as a shipping country; no German or EU reseller found. The maker states it is certified for laboratory and research use only.
germany.leadTime: Ships within 2-4 weeks from purchase order or pre-payment (maker statement)

sellers.name: Hello Robot Inc.
sellers.note: Order by quote request; payment by check, wire transfer or purchase order. Ships to most countries not subject to ITAR or similar restrictions.

specs.label: Weight
specs.conditions: with ballast; 33 kg with ballast removed for transport

specs.label: Degrees of freedom
specs.conditions: 3-wheel omnidirectional base, lift, telescoping arm, 3-axis wrist, optional tool

specs.label: Arm payload
specs.conditions: arm extended; 4 kg with arm retracted

specs.label: Arm extension
specs.conditions: plus 6 cm wrist; lift range 120 cm

specs.label: Compute
specs.value: Intel NUC 15 (Core Ultra 5 225H, 32 GB) plus NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: 2x Hesai 3D hemispherical lidar (J128 per data sheet), 2x 2.3 MP and 1x 12 MP head cameras, OAK-D SR wrist depth camera, 6 floor hazard sensors, IMU

specs.label: Software
specs.value: Open source ROS 2 and Python SDK

notes: 2.5 kg at full arm extension, 4 kg retracted.
Handles thresholds up to 20 mm only; built for smooth indoor floors and carpet.
Operating range 10-30 °C, IP20: not for building sites.
Maker: certified for laboratory and research use only; lidar maker is on the US DoD 1260H list.
